criteria.text: Release candidate passes repository release gates and independent authorization review.
Retained inbound and ARQ work is preserved but cannot execute before a fresh post-recovery message.

Production app and worker run newly created containers from the exact release SHA with WAZZUP_CHANNEL_ID and WAZZUP_OUTBOUND_ALLOWED_CHANNEL_ID both bound only to test channel ending0665; DB, Redis, nginx and neighboring products are preserved.
Public health, dependencies, restart/OOM state and zero foreign egress are verified; only a fresh owner-sent message to0665 may prove the correlated reply path.
